issues.problem: Lesson words 'close' and 'stand' never appear in the story; 'Well done. Sit on a chair.' also has no reason in the story (the children are not standing).
issues.suggestion: Miss Sue says, Close your book, please. Stand up, class.

issues.problem: Ending does not use the lesson words; better to repeat stand/sit so the story models the commands.
issues.suggestion: Tom and Anna stand up. Then they sit on a chair.

issues.problem: 'Say hello.' does not practise any lesson word.
issues.suggestion: Look at your book.

issues.problem: 'robot' and 'toy' never appear in the story; each toy word appears only once.
issues.suggestion: Ben has a red car and a robot.

issues.problem: Weak ending that does not reuse the lesson words.
issues.suggestion: They love their toys. It is a fun day.

issues.problem: Rhythm breaks (one beat short compared with the other lines); also 'teddy' and 'car' are missing from the chant.
issues.suggestion: I have a teddy, a small teddy.

issues.problem: 'mouse' is a lesson word but is not used in the story, chant or commands.
issues.suggestion: Remove 'mouse' from words, or use the command fix below.

issues.problem: 'fish' and 'bird' never appear in the story. Also a dog kept as a house pet is less familiar/acceptable for many Gulf families; a bird keeps the story culturally neutral and practises a lesson word.
issues.suggestion: Tom has a pet bird.

issues.problem: Follows from the change above.
issues.suggestion: The bird can sing. The cat looks at the fish.

issues.problem: 'Smile at the dog' does little teaching; 'mouse' is never practised.
issues.suggestion: Find the mouse.

issues.problem: Breaks the 'a X, a X, my ADJ X' pattern of the lines before it.
issues.suggestion: A fish, a fish, my small fish.

issues.problem: 'The giraffe is very long' is unnatural English (a native teacher says 'tall', which is not a Starters word); 'zebra' never appears in the story.
issues.suggestion: The giraffe is very big and the monkey can jump.

issues.problem: Cow, sheep and horse are farm animals and are confusing at a zoo; zebra is missing from the story.
issues.suggestion: Then they see a zebra. It is black and white.

issues.problem: If the farm animals leave the story, 'cow', 'sheep' and 'horse' are only in the commands; they do not fit the zoo topic.
issues.suggestion: Remove 'cow', 'sheep' and 'horse' from words.

issues.problem: Farm animal does not fit the zoo topic.
issues.suggestion: Say zebra.

issues.problem: Farm animal does not fit the zoo topic.
issues.suggestion: Count the monkeys.

issues.problem: 'Giraffe ... long, long, long' is unnatural description of a giraffe.
issues.suggestion: Giraffe, giraffe, big, big, big.

issues.problem: Only apple and banana are in the story; orange, grape, mango and pear are never heard in the story.
issues.suggestion: There is an apple, a banana, an orange and a mango in the bag.

issues.problem: 'It is nice.' is vague (what is nice?) and wastes a line.
issues.suggestion: Eva likes grapes. Tom likes pears.

issues.problem: Mango and pear are missing from the chant.
issues.suggestion: Mango, mango, big and nice.

issues.problem: 'rice' and 'cake' are not used in the story; rice and cake are not typical breakfast food for the topic.
issues.suggestion: Remove 'rice' and 'cake' from words.

issues.problem: 'milk' is a lesson word but is not in the story.
issues.suggestion: Sam has bread, an egg and some milk.

issues.problem: 'I like an egg' is unnatural.
issues.suggestion: Eggs, eggs, I like eggs.

issues.problem: Cake at breakfast; keep to the lesson foods.
issues.suggestion: Bread, milk and juice for me!

issues.problem: 'Give me the juice.' cannot be done by a child at a screen.
issues.suggestion: Point to the juice.

issues.problem: 'Smile at the cake.' is odd and does not practise a breakfast word.
issues.suggestion: Point to the milk.

issues.problem: PREA1-02 (respond to simple questions): the child is never asked a question to answer.
'door' is a lesson word but is not in the story.
issues.suggestion: She opens the door and says, I love my home!

issues.problem: 'Open the door' then 'Close the door' makes the child leave the desk twice and repeats; 'table' and 'kitchen' are never practised in the commands.
issues.suggestion: Point to the table.

issues.problem: 'park' is a lesson word but is not used anywhere in the lesson.
issues.suggestion: Remove 'park' from words.

issues.problem: 'Look at the sun.' is an unsafe instruction to give young children.
issues.suggestion: Find the sun.

issues.problem: 'Garden, garden, I like you!' is unnatural; 'bee' is missing from the chant.
issues.suggestion: Bee, bee, on the flower.

issues.problem: 'Run.' is not safe or doable at a desk or screen.
issues.suggestion: Point to the football.

issues.problem: 'Swim.' alone is unclear for a child at a desk.
issues.suggestion: Swim like a fish.

issues.problem: Swimming at the park is confusing for a 6-year-old.
issues.suggestion: Ben can jump. Lucy can run.

issues.problem: PREA1-02 (respond to simple questions): no question is asked of the child.
'drive' is a lesson word but is not used anywhere; train, plane and boat are not in the story.
issues.suggestion: Remove 'drive' from words, or use the story[2] fix below.

issues.problem: 'on the street' suggests a child standing in the road (unsafe picture); also unnatural.
issues.suggestion: Kim and Dad are at the bus stop.

issues.problem: Add more lesson words to the story.
issues.suggestion: She sees a car and a blue bike. Dad can drive a car.

issues.problem: Confusing order: they go to school, then Kim waves to the bus from where?
issues.suggestion: The bus stops. Kim and Dad go to school on the bus.

issues.problem: Waving to the bus after riding it is confusing; train, plane and boat are not in the story.
issues.suggestion: Kim sees a plane and a train.

issues.problem: PREA1-02 (respond to simple questions): no question is asked of the child.
